<p class="nv-section-lead">Everything a program declares lives in a class body — and nothing about a class is decided by a method happening to have a particular name.</p>

<section class="nv-section">
<h2 class="nv-section-title"><a href="/docs/rules/classes/declaring-a-class/">Declaring a class</a><span class="nv-section-count">10</span></h2>
<p class="nv-section-blurb">Everything lives in a class body. Constructors, promotion, and the proof that every property is assigned before it is read.</p>
<ol class="nv-rule-list"><li><a href="/docs/rules/classes/declaring-a-class/#no-free-functions-or-constants">No <code>function</code> and no <code>const</code> may be declared outside a class href="/docs/rules/classes/declaring-a-class/#names-resolve-case-sensitively">Every name is compared exactly, so <code>Foo</code> and <code>foo</code> are two names and never one</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/classes/declaring-a-class/#reserved-spellings-are-lower-case">Keywords, contextual keywords and the <code>&lt;?nvs</code> tag are lower case and nothing else</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/classes/declaring-a-class/#no-leading-underscore-identifiers">No property, parameter or local name may begin with <code>_</code></a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a compile</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/classes/declaring-a-class/#promotion-is-constructor-only">A visibility keyword on a parameter promotes it to a property only in the <code>constructor</code></a><span <section class="nv-section">
<h2 class="nv-section-title"><a href="/docs/rules/classes/properties/">Properties, hooks and observers</a><span class="nv-section-count">9</span></h2>
<p class="nv-section-blurb"><code>lateinit</code> for what the constructor cannot fill, hooks for what a read or write should run, and an interface where PHP had <code>__get</code>.</p>
<ol class="nv-rule-list"><li><a href="/docs/rules/classes/properties/#lateinit">A <code>lateinit</code> property is assigned after the constructor rather than inside it</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/classes/properties/#lateinit-restrictions"><code>lateinit</code> is admitted only on a non-nullable class- or interface-typed property that is neither promoted nor <code>readonly</code></a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/classes/properties/#lateinit-read-before-write">A <code>lateinit</code> read the enclosing method can prove is too early is a compile error, and nothing wider is attempted</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/classes/properties/#no-dynamic-properties">A property that the class does not declare cannot be read or written, and no user code runs for the attempt</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/classes/properties/#unset-is-refused-on-a-property"><code>unset</code> on a declared property is a compile error, and <code>isset</code> on one is an ordinary null test</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/classes/properties/#property-hooks">A property's own <code>get</code>/<code>set</code> hook is PHP 8.4's, unchanged, and every read or write of that property is a call to it</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/classes/properties/#property-observer">A class observes every read and write of its own properties by implementing <code>PropertyObserver</code>, never by declaring <code>__get</code>/<code>__set</code></a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/classes/properties/#property-observer-pipeline">A property access runs its hook or its storage first and the observer second, and the observer cannot change the answer</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/classes/properties/#property-observer-costs-nothing-when-unused">A class that implements no <code>PropertyObserver</code> pays nothing for one</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span></li></ol>
</section>
<section class="nv-section">
<h2 class="nv-section-title"><a href="/docs/rules/classes/interfaces-and-delegation/">Interfaces and delegation</a><span class="nv-section-count">6</span></h2>
<p class="nv-section-blurb">There is no <code>trait</code>: shared behaviour is a default method, and shared state is a field you delegate to.</p>
<ol class="nv-rule-list"><li><a href="/docs/rules/classes/interfaces-and-delegation/#member-conflict-is-an-error">A member reachable from two default or delegated sources with no override is a compile error</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="designed">Designed</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/classes/interfaces-and-delegation/#no-traits">There is no <code>trait</code>: shared behaviour is an interface method with a body, shared state is <code>by</code> delegation</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/classes/interfaces-and-delegation/#interface-default-methods">A <code>public</code> interface method with a body is a default method, and <code>$this</code> inside it is the interface</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/classes/interfaces-and-delegation/#interface-private-methods">A <code>private</code> interface method is visible only to that interface's own bodies</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/classes/interfaces-and-delegation/#interfaces-declare-no-state">An interface declares no property: one written there is <code>E0254</code>, and the value comes from a method or a constant</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/classes/interfaces-and-delegation/#delegation-by-field"><code>implements I by $field</code> forwards every member <code>I</code> requires to that property</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span></li></ol>
</section>
<section class="nv-section">
<h2 class="nv-section-title"><a href="/docs/rules/classes/no-magic/">Behaviour is declared, never magic</a><span class="nv-section-count">8</span></h2>
<p class="nv-section-blurb">No method changes a class by being present. Ordering, string conversion and dumping each go through a named interface.</p>
<ol class="nv-rule-list"><li><a href="/docs/rules/classes/no-magic/#comparable">Two objects order only when their class implements <code>Comparable</code>, and there is no property-walk fallback</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/classes/no-magic/#comparable-is-same-class-only"><code>compareTo</code> fixes the other operand to <code>self</code>, so two different classes are never ordered against each other</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/classes/no-magic/#ordering-lowers-to-compare-to"><code>&lt;</code>, <code>&gt;</code>, <code>&lt;=</code>, <code>&gt;=</code> and <code>&lt;=&gt;</code> on two objects lower to one <code>compareTo</code> call</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/classes/no-magic/#stringable">An object becomes a string only through <code>Stringable::toString</code>, and everywhere else is a diagnostic</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/classes/no-magic/#no-magic-methods">No method name changes a class's behaviour by being present; every PHP magic method is replaced by a declared interface or gone</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/classes/no-magic/#no-call-magic">There is no <code>__call</code> or <code>__callStatic</code>: a call to a method the class does not declare is a diagnostic</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/classes/no-magic/#no-destructors">There are no destructors: cleanup is an explicit method call the holder makes</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/classes/no-magic/#no-debug-hook">A debug dump shows a class's real declared properties and their real values, and no class can change that</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li></ol>
</section>
<section class="nv-section">
<h2 class="nv-section-title"><a href="/docs/rules/classes/copying-and-serializing/">Copying and serializing</a><span class="nv-section-count">6</span></h2>
<p class="nv-section-blurb">Two copy depths, neither of which a class customizes, and a serialization format closed to everything it did not write.</p>
<ol class="nv-rule-list"><li><a href="/docs/rules/classes/copying-and-serializing/#two-copy-depths">A copy is either <code>clone</code>'s one level or the graph copy, and no class customizes either</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/classes/copying-and-serializing/#clone-is-shallow"><code>clone</code> copies an object's declared storage one level deep and shares every object it reaches</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/classes/copying-and-serializing/#graph-copy">The graph copy is one recursive, cycle-safe walk with two carriers, and it refuses what has no meaning on the other side</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/classes/copying-and-serializing/#serialize-is-a-closed-format"><code>Core\Serialize::decode</code> accepts only bytes this build's <code>encode</code> produced, and refuses everything else outright</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/classes/copying-and-serializing/#an-encoder-ends-a-cycle-by-identity">Every encoder that walks a value graph ends a cycle by identity and names the path, never by exhausting a depth cap</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/classes/copying-and-serializing/#no-class-alias">A class is reachable under its declared name and nowhere else</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li></ol>
</section>
